summary: Python 3.8 added the walrus operator (:=), positional-only parameters, improved f-string debugging (f'{x=}'), and the typing.TypedDict. The C API was cleaned up. Python 3.8 was the last version to support Windows 7 (Microsoft's extended support ended). Performance improvements continued from the Faster CPython work.
notes: Unsupported since 2024-10-07. Last micro 3.8.20. Full support ended 2021-05-03. The walrus operator (assignment expressions) streamlined loops and conditionals.
